Rooms.Name: The muddy sewer
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in mud to your knees. This is not the kind of place for a
picnic. The muddy sewer stretches further into the south.

Exits.Description: You see the muddy sewer continuing into the darkness to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

Rooms.Name: The muddy sewer junction
Rooms.Description:
The muddy sewer stretches into the dark to the south. It looks as if no
person has ever sat his foot here before. It's too muddy for that anyway. The
sewer leads north, south and east from here.

Exits.Description: The muddy sewer stretches into the dark to the north.
East. The muddy sewer leads into a bend that goes south.
South. The muddy sewer ends in a mudhole that way.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

Rooms.Name: The mudhole
Rooms.Description:
You stand in mud all the way up to your thighs and it's not too comfortable
since you are used to a somewhat different environment. The sewer leads to the
north of here. In the middle you can just make out an enormous drainpipe
leading down.

Exits.Description: North. The muddy junction lies in that direction.
The muddy drainpipe leads down through the mud, otherwise it is utterly dark.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

Rooms.Name: The Dark Pit
Rooms.Description:
You are standing by the edge of a dark pit that leads down into even deeper
darkness. >BWWAAADDRR< - The smell from down there is unbearable. The sewer
stretches into the darkness to the east.

Exits.Description: East. The sewer leads into the sewer junction.

The Dark Pit leads down an down and down ... well you can't see the bottom
anyway. There are bars that function as a ladder on the side.

Rooms.Name: The muddy sewer
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the middle of a bend of the sewer pipe. It is very dark
around here and the mud is sticking to your legs, not very pleasant. The pipe
leads east and south from here.

Exits.Description: East. The mud stretches on into the darkness.

South. There is even more mud in that direction than where you are now.
Incredible.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

Rooms.Name: The muddy sewer
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in something that reminds you very much of porridge, this
has the advantage that it's not hot, it's rather cold actually. The pipe bends
to the north and east.

Exits.Description: The muddy sewer pipe leads into a bend that goes east.

The pipe leads into a bend that goes south. Interesting, there's mud on the
floor there.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

Rooms.Name: The muddy sewer bend
Rooms.Description:
This isn't your idea of a place to stay too long. You're in up to your knees
in something that resembles mud, but you're not quite sure. The bend in which
you stand leads west and south.

Exits.Description:
The pipe leads into a intersection that goes south and east. The floor here is
still covered in mud.

The pipe (still filled with mud) leads into a intersection that goes north and
south. Interesting.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

Rooms.Name: A muddy intersection
Rooms.Description:
You have both your feet safely stuck in mud. It isn't the mud that's wrong
it's the smell, the sounds, the total darkness that surrounds you. Everything
here is so depressing. The pipe leads on with a trail of thick mud to the
north, east and south.

Exits.Description:
North. The pipe goes into a bend with a load of mud all the way up the walls.
The bend leads west.

East. This way like a place for the annual mud festival, although the stench
wouldn't allow any happiness at all. The pipe leads into a bend that leads
north.

South. There's less mud in that direction. *smile*. Your light doesn't cover
enough space for you to see much more than that it leads into some sort of
junction.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

Rooms.Name: The Sewer Junction
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the middle of a huge junction of sewer pipes right under what
you'd think was an air shaft. The sewer pipes lead to the north, south, east
and west. It look quite impossible to force your way up.

Exits.Description: North. Mud is the floor basis in that direction. Yummy.
YYEEUUCH! BOOH! THAT looks like a nice place for creepy crawlies.

North. This direction looks quite nice actually. The pipe leads into a bend
that goes east.

A few yards ahead - away from this junction - there is a pit leading down, but
the smell from there... >PHEWW<.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

Rooms.Name: A bend in sewer pipe
Rooms.Description:
You are in a bend in the sewer pipe. A strong smell seeps in from the north.
The sewer goes north and east.

Exits.Description: North. You are staring into a huge junction with exits in all directions.
East. The Pipe leads into utter darkness that way.

Rooms.Name: The muddy sewer pipe
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a kind of tube intersection that leads south, west and
east. Your legs are covered in mud up to the knees. REAL yucky!

Exits.Description: East. There's less mud in that direction, or that's your impression.

That way is lost in darkness, though you sense less mud in that direction,
perhaps even a complete end to this sludge that surrounds you.
West. The mud reaches that way too, all the way up the walls.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

Rooms.Name: The bend in the Muddy sewer
Rooms.Description:
This is not your idea of a holiday. You stand in mud up to your knees. It's
absolutely inconceivable how all this mud could have been placed here. The pipe
leads to the west and south.

Exits.Description:
South. There's even more mud that way, incredible! Although it looks like an
intersection in the sewer system that leads east and south.

West. All you can see, is that the pipe leads into a bend that goes north. But
there's less mud in that direction, however odd that sounds.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

Rooms.Name: A MUDDY intersection
Rooms.Description:
You wouldn't want to know the true feeling of standing in this mud up to
your hips. >BWAADR<. All that fills your mind right now is the dream of a hot
bath. This is NOT very clean mud you know, remember you're in the sewer! The
pipes leads north, south and east.

Exits.Description:
North. Sludge and sediment fills this corridor of the sewer that leads into a
bend going west.

East. You can see absolutely nothing of interest in that direction (Maybe
that's why it's so damn interesting. ??) There's no mud in that direction
either, GREAT!

South. All you can see is more mud! Although the pipe goes into a bend leading
west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's NOT the kind of matter that would concern you too much, normally, but
as you are in the middle of it, it just might become your main concern.
REAL YUCKY!

It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

Rooms.Name: Muddy sewer
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a bend of the pipe system of the sewer with mud up to your
thighs. Contemplating a higher level of existence here would be utterly
inappropriate, as the smell would keep any intelligent creature from even
thinking of anything but getting away from this foul end of the WORLD. The bend
goes from north to west.

Exits.Description:
North. Filled with mud, that place looks like an impassable intersection with
pipes leading north and east.

West. There's less mud that way, maybe you're on your way out of this foul
place.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

Rooms.Name: The old well
Rooms.Description:
You are standing by an old and worn well from before this century. The sewer
leads to the east from here and the well leads down into darkness. Metal bars
implanted in the side of the well lead down as a ladder.

Exits.Description:
East. You see, because of the utter darkness that surround you, absolutely
nothing. Your light isn't of much use for that kind of distance.

Down the well there's even less light than up here, so ... sorry, you can't see
a thing. There are metal bars in the side leading down into the darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These look like they're pretty slippery, and not very safe, but perhaps safe
enough for you to climb down, WITH both hands on them.

Rooms.Name: The ordinary bend
Rooms.Description:
You are in the middle of a bend in the pipe system of the sewer system, WHAT
a place!!! The pipe leads to the south and the east.

Exits.Description:
East. What a quiet place you've found there. It's an intersection that has
pipeways going north and east.
South. You see nothing at all in that direction it's too dark anyway.

Rooms.Name: The sewer junction
Rooms.Description: You are in a junction that leads north, west and south.

Exits.Description: North. You see a bend.

South. It looks like a pipe junction just like this one. Only that one leads
east and west.
West. There's a junction with four pipelines in that direction.

Rooms.Name: The ordinary junction
Rooms.Description:
This looks like an ordinary junction, actually it seems very quiet here. The
pipelines lead west, east and north.

Exits.Description: To the north you can see a junction like this one, leading north and west.

To the east there's nothing of particular interest, though there's a junction
with pipelines leading north and east.
There's a bend to the west leading north.

Rooms.Name: A quiet pipe junction
Rooms.Description:
This is the kind of place to rest, though the smell could be a LOT better
than this. The sewer goes east, north and west from here.

Exits.Description: In that direction, you can't see anything. It's just too dark.
There's an ordinary junction in the pipe system to the east

West. There's an ordinary bend leading south into the sewer system in that
direction.

Rooms.Name: The odd room with smooth walls
Rooms.Description:
As you enter you hear a loud click from one of the walls ... and you fall
and fall and fall ... . . . . ... And come to an abrupt end. THIS is strange
indeed. There's an arched entryway leading down.

Exits.Description:
Down. It's utterly dark that way, though you can make out an intersection of
sewer pipes leading west, north and east.

Rooms.Name: The sewer
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in mud up to your ankles. This is an intersection with
sewer pipes leading east, south and west.

Exits.Description: To the east there's a peculiar looking round room.
To the south there's another intersection with pipes going south and east.

To the west there's another intersection like this one, with sewer pipes
leading south and west.

Rooms.Name: Another intersection
Rooms.Description:
You have never seen anything so BORING... This is an intersection with pipes
leading north, south and east.

Exits.Description:
To the north there's an intersection, where the pipes are leading west and
east. You notice that the floor to the west is covered in mud.

East. You see nothing of interest in that direction, just another intersection.
This one leads east and south.
Another intersection lies to the south. It leads west and south.

Rooms.Name: A junction
Rooms.Description:
This one seems interesting, a big difference from all the other junctions.
It seems cleaner than the rest of them. Weird. Something that looks like an air
shaft leads upwards, but it looks far too slippery to climb. The pipes lead to
the south, west and north.

Exits.Description: North. You see an intersection there, leading north and east.
To the south there's ANOTHER junction leading west and east.

To the west you see a load of mud and sediment in the sewer. That should be an
intersection there but you're not quite sure.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

Rooms.Name: The sewer junction
Rooms.Description: You stand in a junction of sewer pipes leading north, east and west.

Exits.Description: To the east you can see a bend in the pipe going south.
To the west you can just make out an old well.

Rooms.Name: The Triple Junction
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the middle of a huge junction of concrete sewer pipes. The
pipes lead into three different directions : east, south and west.

Exits.Description: East. You can see a bend in the sewer pipe leading north.

To the south there's a ENORMOUS quadruple sewer junction, all lit up by an odd
light.

To the west you can just make out another junction similar to the one you are
standing in.

Rooms.Name: The Quadruple Junction Under the Dump
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in something that reminds you of an entry to an ant hive.
There are enormous concrete pipes leading north, south, east and west. There's
also a metal ladder built into the concrete wall leading up through a layer of
garbage.

Exits.Description:
To the north you can see a huge triple junction with sewer pipes leading west
and east.
East. You can see a pit in the floor.
To the south there's a huge junction with pipes leading east and west.
To the west there's an odd looking room with totally smooth walls.

Up through the garbage you can just make out what looks like the Dump in
Midgaard.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks as if it's made of stainless steel, and it would very well function
as a club of considerable power, but alas ...  You can't take at all since
it's firmly set into the concrete wall.

Rooms.Name: A triple junction
Rooms.Description: You stand in a junction with pipes leading west, north and east.

Exits.Description:
To the north there's a ENORMOUS quadruple sewer junction, all lit up by an odd
light.
East. You can just make out a triple junction leading north and east.
West. You can just make out a triple junction leading north and west.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the sewer pipe
Rooms.Description: You can look in two directions where the pipe leads : south and west.

Exits.Description: To the south you can see another bend leading west.
West. You can just make out a triple junction leading north and west.

Rooms.Name: The sewer pipe bend
Rooms.Description:
You can look in two different directions where the pipe goes : west and
north.

Exits.Description: North. You see another bend leading west.

You can see another junction although this one is a triple one with pipes going
south and west.

Rooms.Name: The pit
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a section of a pipe that leads to a dead end. In the floor
there's a pit leading down. There are bars set in the side of the pit wall
functioning as a ladder.

Exits.Description: West. You can see a dimly lit quadruple junction with an exit up.
Down the pit it's utterly dark you can't see a thing.

Rooms.Name: The round room
Rooms.Description:
As you enter the room it starts rotating - at first slowly, later faster and
faster - You get totally confused as to where up and down is, but you are
certain that the doorway is in the opposite direction of what it was when you
entered. It now leads east. There was only this one exit.

Exits.Description: You can just make out a smaller room with a chair.

Rooms.Name: The three way junction
Rooms.Description: You are standing in a junction of pipes that lead west, east and south.

Exits.Description: East. You can make out a dimly lit Guard Room.
To the south you can see what looks like a store room.
West. You see another junction similar to this one leading north and south.

Rooms.Name: The Sewer Store Room
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a small room lit by a single torch set in the wall. The only
way out of here is to the north.

Exits.Description: To the north you see a pipe junction.

Rooms.Name: The Shaft
Rooms.Description:
You are standing by the edge of a deep, dark shaft leading down. A single
ladder is your tool to work your way down if you so wish. The sewer pipe leads
south from here.

Exits.Description: To the south you can see the pipe leading further south into darkness.

Down and utter darkness. There's absolutely nothing to be seen in that
direction.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Firmly set into the wall of the shaft it's impossible to even rock, is your
estimate.

Rooms.Name: The Sewer Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the middle of a pipe that leads from north to south. Above you
an air shaft leads up into sunlight. It seems totally impossible to go up that
way.

Exits.Description: To the north you can just make out a huge shaft leading down.
To the south you can see a triple junction leading west and east.

Rooms.Name: The junction going three ways
Rooms.Description:
You are in a passageway in the pipes of the sewer system leading north, east
and west.

Exits.Description: You see a sewer pipe leading north.

West. You see another junction very similar to this one that leads north and
west.

Rooms.Name: The Sewer Room
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a large room with chairs set in the walls. You have the
feeling of being watched. To the south there's an entry to a larger room. The
room is lit by five torches, also set in the walls. To the west there is a
doorway leading out to the sewers.

Exits.Description: You can see an even larger room than this one, filled with light.
To the west you can see the sewers.

Rooms.Name: The Sewer room
Rooms.Description:
This is a Room with walls that glitters like gold though not quite like it.
This is strange as it looks as if the glitter lights the whole room. It looks
very bright. To the south the floor is covered with yucky water. The North
leads to sort of a Guard Room.

Exits.Description: To the north you can see the guard room.
To the south there is nothing but water and an exit leads east from there.

Rooms.Name: The Pool in the sewer
Rooms.Description:
You stand in water to your waste. To the north is the entrance to this room.
A single door leads east.

Exits.Description: To the north you see the entrance to this room.
You can see an enormous hall through the doorway.

Rooms.Name: The Sewers
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a dead end of the sewer. The only way out is south. You can see
a shaft leading up but it looks too difficult to go up that way.

Rooms.Name: The junction
Rooms.Description: You stand in a junction leading north, west and east.

Exits.Description:
Darkness has closed in on that part of the sewer system, you can't see a thing
in that direction.

West. You see another junction very similar to this one that leads north and
west.

Rooms.Name: The small room
Rooms.Description:
The only thing in this room of interest is a chair, and that's tight to the
rock floor. A doorway leads south and another leads east into darkness.

Exits.Description: Utter darkness... !
You can see a room with a lot of light in it. You can't make out any details.

Rooms.Name: The Sewer pipe
Rooms.Description:
You are in what reminds you of a foul sewer, as if you liked being here! You
can see two exits leading either north or south.

Exits.Description: To the south you can see a strange light flowing from there.

Rooms.Name: The Grand Sewer
Rooms.Description:
You are in a Grand Sewer Pipe. This stretches toward the south. It's large
indeed! A doorway leads to the east from here.

Exits.Description: To the north you can see a doorway.
You can't see anything in that darkness.
In the south end of the pipe the "floor" is completely covered with water.

Rooms.Name: The South end of the Grand Pipe
Rooms.Description:
You stand in water to your knees. A doorway leads west from here. The Pipe
stretches north.

Exits.Description: You see a lot of pictures decorating the walls.

Rooms.Name: The Edge of The Water Sewer
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a room where half of the floor is covered in water. The water
leads east and a doorway leads west.

Exits.Description:
You can hardly make out much more than that the next place is in a pipe with
more water.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

Rooms.Name: The Dark hallway
Rooms.Description:
You can't see much of this, even with a light. The hallway goes into a
passageway to the south. A doorway leads west.

Exits.Description: You can see nothing at all because it's completely dark in that direction.
You see a lot of light, bright as daylight, but nothing of interest.

Rooms.Name: The dark passageway
Rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
passageway seems to continue south and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

Rooms.Name: The dark passageway
Rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
passageway seems to continue south and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

Rooms.Name: The dark passageway
Rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
passageway seems to continue south and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

Rooms.Name: The dark passageway
Rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
passageway seems to continue west and north. To the east there's water covering
the floor and that leads through an arched entry to a watery sewer.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.
You can just make out a triple junction leading north and west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

Rooms.Name: The Watery Sewer Bend
Rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to bend and lead south and west.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

Rooms.Name: The Watery sewer
Rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

Rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

Rooms.Name: The Watery Sewer Junction
Rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead into a junction going south, north and east.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light

Rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

Rooms.Name: The Watery sewer junction
Rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead into a junction that goes north, south and east.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light

Rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

Rooms.Name: The Watery sewer bend
Rooms.Description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to bend and lead west and north.

Exits.Description:
You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light
that far.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

Rooms.Name: A ledge by the dark pool
Rooms.Description:
You can't see much here but the echo tells you that there's quite a drop
down. You can just make out a huge dark pool out there in the darkness, mostly
because of the trickling of water. The water from the sewer actually washes
over this ledge and makes it quite slippery. From here it drops, like a
waterfall, into the pool far down.

Exits.Description: You can't see a thing. It's too dark.
You can't see a thing. It's too dark.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

Rooms.Name: A ledge by the dark pool
Rooms.Description:
You can't see much here but the echo tells you that there's quite a drop
down. You can just make out a huge dark pool out there in the darkness, mostly
because of the trickling of water. The water from the sewer actually washes
over this ledge and makes it quite slippery. From here it drops, like a
waterfall, into the pool far down. Under you there is a small fissure in the
rock. It seems big enough to contain a few people.

Exits.Description: You can't see a thing. It's too dark.
You can't see a thing. It's too dark.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.

Rooms.Name: The fissure under the ledge
Rooms.Description:
This is a small fissure in the solid rock. Under you lies the deep dark
pool. The water trickles quietly down from the ledge above you. The water
smells like the water in a sewer.

Exits.Description: The water edge.

Mobs.Name: bat
Mobs.LongDescription: The small fierce-looking bat is hanging from the ceiling, obviously sleeping.
Mobs.Description:
You have never in your entire life seen such a mean looking small creature,
though it looks rather peaceful, hanging there, sleeping.  The thought of 
arousing this cruel creature doesn't sit well in your bones.

Mobs.Name: rat
Mobs.LongDescription: The huge hungry-looking sewer rat sits here.

Mobs.Name: spider
Mobs.LongDescription: The small hairy Spider is here, busy with its web.
